verdict.rationale: Trello is a visual project-management and kanban SaaS, not a coding agent or execution environment, so auto-detecting and installing toolchains for a coding task is outside its product category. The MCP server and AI writing-assist items connect Trello to AI tools or help draft content. They do not show Trello running a coding agent that provisions dependencies, so the axis does not flip to applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can have a coding agent auto-detect and install the toolchains and dependencies it needs for a task
